row.title: Propose post-authorisation immunogenicity evaluation as additional PV with clearly defined objectives
row.statement: If immunogenicity is included in the safety specification, the applicant/MAH shall propose relevant strategies for evaluating immunogenicity and its clinical consequences post-authorisation as an additional pharmacovigilance activity, and these activities shall have clearly defined objectives.
row.quote: If immunogenicity is included in the safety specification, relevant strategies for the evaluation of immunogenicity and associated clinical consequences in the post-authorization setting shall be proposed 193 GVP Guideline in Egypt GVP Guideline as an additional pharmacovigilance activity. Depending on the nature of any potential immunogenicity and the data that generated the concern, or the nature of the missing information, the additional pharmacovigilance activities shall have clearly defined objectives.
